## Complete Prohibited-Input Firewall

The future author must not open:

- [`README.md`](README.md), [`PRIOR_WORK.md`](PRIOR_WORK.md),
  [`INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md`](INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md),
  [`OWNERSHIP_AND_BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION.md`](OWNERSHIP_AND_BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION.md),
  [`DECISION_LOG.md`](DECISION_LOG.md),
  [`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md`](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md),
  [`STAGE_A_CHANGE_LOG.md`](STAGE_A_CHANGE_LOG.md), the raw owner launch
  record, or the raw final-repair directive;
- historical NOI owner/coordinator briefs, audits, findings, repairs,
  re-audits, integration records, cross-audit handoffs, and evidence results;
- current or historical Citlali implementation, source, headers, schemas,
  configuration, product contracts, tests, generated products, accepted runs,
  validation, reductions, Unity, achieved performance, defaults, or historical
  behavior;
- `doc/citlali_noise_estimation_plan.tex`, Convolve material, historical
  counts/defaults, or implementation vocabulary;
- the full frozen MAP, JINC, RTC, CAL, PTC, AST, VAL, BEAM, FLT, SRC/MODE,
  FRUIT, or other package;
- any unlisted local file, repository, web source, external paper, or
  model-memory substitute.

If the exclusive packet is insufficient, the author must return one precise
scientific question. It may not inspect prohibited material or select a
scientific default.

## Author Controls

Only after Grant Wilson approves every ODQ-101--110 disposition, the exact ten
logical items and hashes, the conditional PTC-route inclusion, and the required
source/profile bindings may a fresh implementation-blind author be dispatched.
That author must:

- use `NOI-GEN`, `NOI-UNC`, and `NOI-STD`; never bare NOI family symbols;
- preserve the hard role boundaries and immutable parent claims;
- preserve exact fixed-state/relearned DAGs and no-mixed-ensemble rule;
- state exact ensemble design, source imprint, target/estimator/covariance/rank,
  STD scale/claim, profile, lifecycle, and failure semantics;
- formalize approved choices and analyze only questions explicitly delegated;
- return one shared normative core plus scientist-readable rationale and
  engineering conformance views; and
- make no implementation-conformity, empirical-calibration, physical-noise,
  Gaussian-significance, performance, readiness, or production claim.
